member.name: T:Diti365.Contracts.Common.LocationPing
member.summary:
One entry from the phone's location outbox.
`IsMockLocation` is reported by the device rather than trusted as proof of honesty: a spoofed ping is uploaded and stored flagged, so the attempt leaves a trace. The server never lets a flagged ping count as a real position.
